components/chat/src/lib/session/stream-e: Projects a settled tool result onto chat's versioned stream wire (version 3) without parts: rendering parts in chat is outside COR-792, and adding them to the wire is that follow-up's change, not a silent drop of a field the wire carries.
packages/armorer/src/adapters/anthropic/: formatAnthropicToolResults sends parts as text, image, and PDF blocks through toolResultParts; any other part is refused.
packages/armorer/src/adapters/gemini/ind: formatGeminiToolResults sends parts as inline functionResponse.parts referenced by $ref; any other part is refused.
packages/armorer/src/adapters/open-ai/ag: A result with parts reaches the agent as their text through toolResultParts; a media part is refused. content is read only for an error message.
packages/armorer/src/adapters/openai/ind: formatOpenAIToolResults sends text parts in order through toolResultParts; a media part is refused.
packages/armorer/src/integrations/mcp/co: toCallToolResult converts parts to MCP blocks, for errors too; parseMcpCallResult produces parts.
packages/conversationalist/src/adapters/: A result with parts travels with its structured result, parts included, in the embedded metadata.
toToolResultBlock sends parts, for any outcome, as text (with citations), image, and document blocks.
toFunctionResponsePart sends parts as inline functionResponse.parts referenced by $ref, for any outcome.
stringifyToolResult serves results without parts; each adapter routes a result with parts to its parts path first.
packages/conversationalist/src/plugins/p: Redacts parts' text and media fields beside content.
packages/operative/src/conditions/predic: The loop fingerprint reads parts in place of content when a result has them.
estimateMessage costs text parts as text and media parts through the media cost estimator.
